Facebook About/Page-info section (the most likely source) was not reachable due to the login wall. Registered null, not fabricated.
groomer_name_from_reviews: Dana. Named by first name across more than a dozen independent reviews spanning roughly 2015-2023 (e.g. 'Dana has been our choice of grooming for 8 years', 'I love Dana - have been going to her for over 16 years', 'Dana is amazing...15 years'). One review ('the owner and her assistant were friendly') implies a two-person shop; not asserting Dana's ownership title since that specific fact is not independently confirmed, so the site refers to her as the salon's longtime groomer, not explicitly 'the owner'.

photos.curation_notes: Every photo viewed individually before selecting (no filename-only picking). Kept: two crisp portraits of a freshly groomed Shih Tzu with a clean trim and ribbon (same grooming session, two angles), one happy well-groomed Bichon, one photo of two groomed Shih Tzus together at a client's home, and one real inside-the-salon photo showing the cage-free resting area (a groomed dog with a bandana resting calmly on a towel next to a kennel/crate on the salon's tile floor), which independently corroborates the many reviews describing a cage-free, calm environment. No selfies, no staff portraits used as tiles, no screenshots, no text overlays.

reviews_verbatim.author: Michael Cullen
reviews_verbatim.text: A pets place is the only place we trust to take care of our Saint Bernard Buda. They do an awesome job. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone.

reviews_verbatim.author: Vera Conner
reviews_verbatim.text: I love Dana - have been going to her for over 16 years and I have followed her everywhere. She does an awesome job even when the dogs are aggressive - she knows how to handle. She has done my collie/husky mix and both of my American Bulldogs - they all love her - great job!!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Laurie Guminski
reviews_verbatim.text: Dana is amazing. She always gets me in quickly and does an amazing job. I've been having my pets groomed for over 15 years and she is by far my favorite groomer. I will never take my fur babies anywhere else.

reviews_verbatim.author: Nancy Vigeant
reviews_verbatim.text: Very clean place and our dog had the best grooming ever. She is definitely our new groomer! I highly recommend giving this place a try!

reviews_verbatim.author: Rob James III
reviews_verbatim.text: Dana has been our choice of grooming for 8 years at least. I cannot say enough good things about her and her work. Both our dogs that she has groomed loved going to see her and the quality of work is second to none. But the best part is she doesn't kennel the dogs she only has one there at a time.
